criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
criteria.evidence: Observed 2026-08-16: all 9 tabs served 200 with zero page errors; Overview carries 23 drill-down links; clicking one landed on detail.html?card=systems and rendered content.

criteria.text: Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.
criteria.evidence: Observed 2026-08-16: pressing Sample renders the banner "Sample data - believable made-up values ... Nothing here is a record of anything this project has produced." Occurrences of the word sample rise from 1 to 18.

criteria.text: Given the data files, when any tab renders, then its content comes from .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json read at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given .colaberry/manifest.json, when any tab is shown, then it displays how old the data is and warns when that age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
criteria.evidence: Observed 2026-08-16: in Real mode every system reads "never checked" and every count reads 0, under the line "Grey is unknown. Nothing here turns green until something real reports in." Caveat: the hard-coded plan still says 12 stories where the current plan has 14, which is a symptom of criterion 3 being unmet.

stories.notes: Ticked by the Colaberry platform team during a pre-cohort end-to-end rehearsal on 2026-08-16, not by the student. Only the three criteria directly observed in a browser are marked passing. Criteria 3 (render from .colaberry/plan.json and progress.json at runtime) and 4 (manifest age and stale warning) are left FALSE because they are genuinely unmet: the Command Center makes no network request for any .colaberry file and contains no reference to manifest.json. This build was written against the earlier 3-criteria version of STORY-000 and is two criteria short of the current 5-criteria definition.

outstanding: Given the data files, when any tab renders, then its content comes from .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json read at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given .colaberry/manifest.json, when any tab is shown, then it displays how old the data is and warns when that age exceeds a week.
